text: This code iterates through the list `xs` and checks each element to see if it matches the `target`. If a match is found, it returns the index of the match, but with a twist: it adds 1 to the index. This means the returned index will be 1 more than the actual index of the first occurrence. If no match is found after checking all elements, it returns -1. The code does not handle edge cases such as an empty list or a list with a single element, and it does not check for the case where the target is not found at all.
